version.description: AgentStrap plugin version that wrote this config.

type.description: Free-form, e.g. web-app, cli, library, docs.

vault_path.description: Absolute or project-relative path to the git repo holding the handoff (usually the docs vault or project root).

handoff_file.description: Path of HANDOFF.md relative to vault_path.

delta_file.description: Path of DELTA_TRACKING.md relative to vault_path.

push.description: If false, hooks write files but never git-push (rely entirely on an external committer).

obsidian_enabled.description: If true and Obsidian is running, the Stop hook leaves pushing to obsidian-git (single-writer rule); SessionEnd still guarantees a safe push.

field.description: JSON key, TOML key, or a regex tag identifying the version string.
